mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,300 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and construction activity, leading to elevated corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS > 149000) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.8%) indicate a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and consumer spending, which drives positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where both PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 3.8.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (INDPRO < 105.0) signals weakening manufacturing output, prompting monetary policy accommodation that generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 500,000) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where RSAFS < 500,000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), a rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.0% triggers aggressive monetary tightening, suppressing equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1300.0) indicate broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where both INDPRO < 105.0 and HOUST < 1300.0.
